description: Start making new memories while you spend your Golden Years on the quiet edge of a sunlit pond in the lovely Stillwaters Estates! This 1,378sf Manchester home makes a lovely first impression with a stunning beveled-glass entry door & a bright, spacious interior filled with natural light. Inside, the spacious Living and Dining Rooms flow seamlessly into a semi-open kitchen, creating an inviting space to gather. The generous Primary Suite captures those lovely pond views, and features a walk-in closet and oversized walk-in shower. Two additional bedrooms offer endless possibilities for guests, a home office, or your favorite hobbies. Just outside the living room is a wrap-around porch—your front-row seat to gorgeous sunsets, birds in flight, & the ever-changing wildlife around the pond! It’s the perfect spot for morning coffee, afternoon unwinding, or entertaining friends as the sun goes down. Situated in a setting that invites you to slow down & savor the moment, this home is ready to make every day living feel a little more special! Located in Stillwaters Estates, Lewis County's premier 55+ gated, NON-HOA, privately owned & professionally managed community, where all the homes are
